question: How many total customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer;

question: List all genres in alphabetical order.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre ORDER BY Name ASC;

question: What is the total number of tracks in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track;

question: Find the first and last name of all employees who have the title 'Sales Support Agent'.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent';

question: Find the names of all artists whose name starts with 'The'.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Artist WHERE Name LIKE 'The%' ORDER BY Name ASC;

question: How many invoices were billed to the country 'USA'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'USA';

question: What is the total invoice amount across all invoices rounded to 2 decimal places?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice;

question: Find the top 5 most expensive tracks based on unit price.
gold_sql: SELECT Name, UnitPrice FROM Track ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC, Name ASC LIMIT 5;

question: Find all distinct countries where customers live in alphabetical order.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM Customer ORDER BY Country ASC;

question: What is the total duration in milliseconds of all tracks combined?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Milliseconds) FROM Track;

question: List the titles of all albums by the artist 'AC/DC'.
gold_sql: SELECT Album.Title FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId WHERE Artist.Name = 'AC/DC' ORDER BY Album.Title ASC;

question: Find the total number of invoices issued in the year 2010.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2010';

question: How many customers are from Canada?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Canada';

question: What is the title and hire date of the employee named 'Andrew Adams'?
gold_sql: SELECT Title, HireDate FROM Employee WHERE FirstName = 'Andrew' AND LastName = 'Adams';

question: How many tracks have a Composer listed (composer is not null)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Composer IS NOT NULL;

question: Find the top 5 customers who spent the most money overall.
gold_sql: SELECT Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName, ROUND(SUM(Invoice.Total), 2) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which genre has the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT Genre.Name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre JOIN Track ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId GROUP BY Genre.GenreId ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many tracks are longer than 5 minutes (300000 milliseconds)?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000;

question: Find the total revenue generated from each billing country, ordered from highest to lowest.
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS TotalRevenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC;

question: List the 5 artists with the highest number of albums.
gold_sql: SELECT Artist.Name, COUNT(Album.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC, Artist.Name ASC LIMIT 5;

question: Find the number of customers assigned to each sales support representative.
gold_sql: SELECT Employee.FirstName, Employee.LastName, COUNT(Customer.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount FROM Employee JOIN Customer ON Employee.EmployeeId = Customer.SupportRepId GROUP BY Employee.EmployeeId ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC;

question: List all playlists and the number of tracks they contain.
gold_sql: SELECT Playlist.Name, COUNT(PlaylistTrack.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Playlist LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Playlist.PlaylistId = PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId GROUP BY Playlist.PlaylistId ORDER BY TrackCount DESC;

question: Find the average invoice total for each billing country that has at least 5 invoices.
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS AvgTotal FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING COUNT(InvoiceId) >= 5 ORDER BY AvgTotal DESC;

question: Which media type is associated with the fewest tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT MediaType.Name, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM MediaType JOIN Track ON MediaType.MediaTypeId = Track.MediaTypeId GROUP BY MediaType.MediaTypeId ORDER BY TrackCount ASC LIMIT 1;

question: Find the total number of tracks purchased from the album 'Balls to the Wall'.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(InvoiceLine.InvoiceLineId) FROM InvoiceLine JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId WHERE Album.Title = 'Balls to the Wall';

question: Find the top 3 cities with the highest total invoice revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCity, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS TotalCityRevenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCity ORDER BY TotalCityRevenue DESC LIMIT 3;

question: List the full name and email of all customers whose support rep is 'Jane Peacock'.
gold_sql: SELECT Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName, Customer.Email FROM Customer JOIN Employee ON Customer.SupportRepId = Employee.EmployeeId WHERE Employee.FirstName = 'Jane' AND Employee.LastName = 'Peacock' ORDER BY Customer.LastName ASC;

question: What is the total sales amount for the year 2011 rounded to 2 decimal places?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2011';

question: Find the 5 longest tracks by duration and their corresponding album titles.
gold_sql: SELECT Track.Name, Album.Title, Track.Milliseconds FROM Track JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId ORDER BY Track.Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Find the total number of invoices where the billing postal code is missing (NULL).
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingPostalCode IS NULL;

question: What is the average track duration in seconds for the 'Rock' genre?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Track.Milliseconds) / 1000.0, 2) FROM Track JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId WHERE Genre.Name = 'Rock';

question: List all customers who have made total purchases exceeding 45 dollars.
gold_sql: SELECT Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName, ROUND(SUM(Invoice.Total), 2) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId HAVING TotalSpent > 45 ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC;

question: Find the first and last name of the employee who reports to no one.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NULL;

question: Which track has been purchased the most times across all invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT Track.Name, COUNT(InvoiceLine.InvoiceLineId) AS PurchaseCount FROM Track JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId GROUP BY Track.TrackId ORDER BY PurchaseCount DESC, Track.Name ASC LIMIT 1;

question: Find the count of distinct artists who have tracks in the 'Jazz' genre.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Artist.ArtistId) FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId WHERE Genre.Name = 'Jazz';

question: Find the top 3 best-selling artists based on the total quantity of tracks sold.
gold_sql: SELECT Artist.Name, SUM(InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS UnitsSold FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId ORDER BY UnitsSold DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Find the IDs and names of all customers who have never had an invoice recorded.
gold_sql: SELECT Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName FROM Customer LEFT JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId WHERE Invoice.InvoiceId IS NULL;

question: Which genre generated the highest total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT Genre.Name, ROUND(SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity), 2) AS TotalRevenue FROM Genre JOIN Track ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId GROUP BY Genre.GenreId ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Find the customer who spent the most money in the year 2012.
gold_sql: SELECT Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName, ROUND(SUM(Invoice.Total), 2) AS Total2012 FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId WHERE strftime('%Y', Invoice.InvoiceDate) = '2012' GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId ORDER BY Total2012 DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Find the IDs and names of all tracks that have never been purchased.
gold_sql: SELECT Track.TrackId, Track.Name FROM Track LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId WHERE InvoiceLine.InvoiceLineId IS NULL ORDER BY Track.Name ASC;

question: Find the titles of all albums that have strictly more than 20 tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT Album.Title, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Album JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId GROUP BY Album.AlbumId HAVING TrackCount > 20 ORDER BY TrackCount DESC;

question: For each employee who manages other employees, count how many employees report to them directly.
gold_sql: SELECT Mgr.FirstName, Mgr.LastName, COUNT(Emp.EmployeeId) AS DirectReports FROM Employee Mgr JOIN Employee Emp ON Mgr.EmployeeId = Emp.ReportsTo GROUP BY Mgr.EmployeeId ORDER BY DirectReports DESC;

question: Find the country whose customers purchased the largest total quantity of tracks.
gold_sql: SELECT Customer.Country, SUM(InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS TotalTracksPurchased FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine ON Invoice.InvoiceId = InvoiceLine.InvoiceId GROUP BY Customer.Country ORDER BY TotalTracksPurchased DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List the names of artists who have tracks in both the 'Rock' and 'Metal' genres.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Artist.Name FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId WHERE Genre.Name = 'Rock' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT Artist.Name FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId WHERE Genre.Name = 'Metal' ORDER BY Name ASC;

question: Find the customer ID and name of the customer who has purchased tracks from the highest number of distinct genres.
gold_sql: SELECT Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName, Customer.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT Track.GenreId) AS GenreCount FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine ON Invoice.InvoiceId = InvoiceLine.InvoiceId JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId ORDER BY GenreCount DESC, Customer.CustomerId ASC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the difference in milliseconds between the longest track and shortest track?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(Milliseconds) - MIN(Milliseconds) AS DurationDiff FROM Track;

question: Which playlist has the longest total duration in hours rounded to 2 decimal places?
gold_sql: SELECT Playlist.Name, ROUND(SUM(Track.Milliseconds) / 3600000.0, 2) AS DurationHours FROM Playlist JOIN PlaylistTrack ON Playlist.PlaylistId = PlaylistTrack.PlaylistId JOIN Track ON PlaylistTrack.TrackId = Track.TrackId GROUP BY Playlist.PlaylistId ORDER BY DurationHours DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Find the percentage of total invoices that were billed to the USA rounded to 2 decimal places.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN BillingCountry = 'USA' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS USAPercentage FROM Invoice;

question: Find the names of all artists who have released albums but have zero tracks sold.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Artist.Name FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId JOIN Track ON Album.AlbumId = Track.AlbumId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine ON Track.TrackId = InvoiceLine.TrackId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId HAVING COUNT(InvoiceLine.InvoiceLineId) = 0 ORDER BY Artist.Name ASC;

question: Find the two-digit month with the highest total sales across all recorded years.
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) AS Month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS MonthlySales FROM Invoice GROUP BY Month ORDER BY MonthlySales DESC LIMIT 1;
